top_story.headline: Quiet Sunday: no new disclosures, foreign-agent contacts or lobbying signals
top_story.dek: Nothing in this window rose to the level of a lead story.
paragraphs: No new House or Senate financial disclosures, FARA filings, Office of Government Ethics filings or flagged lobbying activity turned up in the monitoring window. The only new items were seven routine third-quarter lobbying activity reports.

The Senate eFD checks for new reports, annual-report deadlines and extensions failed with a parsing error this run, so the absence of Senate disclosures below reflects a gap in coverage rather than a confirmed absence of filings.

sections.headline: No new flagged or routine ethics filings reported by the Office of Government Ethics
paragraphs: The Office of Government Ethics recorded no new filings within the monitoring window, leaving all tracked registries quiet for this cycle.

sections.headline: Seven routine third-quarter reports, no registrations or terminations
paragraphs: Seven LDA filings posted since October 31, all 3rd Quarter activity reports. There were no new registrations and no terminations, and none of the reports carried a signal (covered former officials, foreign entities, conviction disclosures or unusual clients), so all seven are left out of the table.

footer.coverage_window: FARA and LDA filings posted October 31, 2026 onward; House and Senate financial disclosures filed October 29, 2026 onward and not reported in earlier editions; PM edition, Sunday, November 1, 2026.
footer.sources: OGE ethics-filing search; DOJ FARA e-file system; LDA API (lda.gov); Clerk of the House financial disclosures; Senate eFD.
footer.known_gaps: Senate eFD fetch failed (Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)), so Senate disclosures could not be checked. The Senate annual-report deadline check and the Senate extensions check failed with the same error, so the Deadline Watch extra has no Senate findings. The Office of Government Ethics reported no new filings in its monitoring window and listed no other known gaps.
